name: Extrusion; at plant
description: This process represents the energy required for material extrusion and must be paired with the specific material intended for extrusion. Extrusion is used in the production of many packaging materials such as sheets and films. Common resins include polyethylene, polypropylene, polycarbonate, and polystyrene.

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Data was collected in the 1990s. Data was reviewed and compared to other inventories and deemed representative of modern extrusion technologies.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This process represents extrusion performed in the US.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Average US extrusion technology. Extrusion is used in the production of many packaging materials such as sheets and films. Common resins include polyethylenes and polypropylene.
processDocumentation.completenessDescription:
Treatment of Missing Environmental Data: This process only includes the electricity required to extrude material (the default is 1 kg of material). 

Treatment of Missing Technosphere Data: This process only includes the electricity required to extrude material (the default is 1 kg of material). 

Mass Balance: A mass balance is not needed for this process.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Data was collected from primary producers and secondary literature and aggregated.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Data was collected from primary producers and secondary literature and aggregated.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: System boundary: This process only includes the electricity required to extrude material (the default is 1 kg of material).
processDocumentation.useAdvice: This process represents the energy required for material extrusion and must be paired with the specific material intended for extrusion.
processDocumentation.intendedApplication: Situation C1 - Accounting, with system-external interactions - The intended application is a purely descriptive accounting / documentation of the analysed system including existing interactions with other systems in the LCI model. These data are an update to a previously published dataset which is a generic unit process model. A full inventory of environmental flows are included in the upstream electricity process; thus this unit process can be used for a full range of LCIA impact categories. The target audience of this model includes LCA practitioners, industry, and the general public.
